scope: Exactly150 previously sealed and causally audited complete episodes; no incomplete or retried-error cases; no new rollout, training or parameter change.
notice: Planner repetition is an observed failure pattern, not proof of which layer caused it. Calibrated GRASP outcome estimates are not privileged physical truth; unchanged intent after estimated success does not itself prove an ignored correct signal. NO_FEEDBACK is the initial none sentinel, not UNKNOWN.
sampling_limitation: Completed cases so far cover18 tasks, not a random or complete sample of100; do not generalize these proportions to the whole benchmark.
